children: GOOG reported Cloud operating income of $8.814B in Q2, up from $2.826B a year earlier, showing strong year-over-year growth in its cloud segment.
Anthropic committed about $111 billion to Google Cloud, representing roughly 22% of Alphabet Class C (GOOG)’s disclosed cloud backlog — a major concentration in GOOG’s backlog figures.
Scotiabank said an Anthropic IPO would turn Alphabet Class C (GOOG)'s private stake into a tradable asset, valuing that stake at about $16 per GOOG share, ~5% of GOOG equity.
GOOG joined as an institutional backer in Jio Platforms’ $3.2B IPO, fully subscribed in under two hours; institutions bid ~2.8x their allotment and GOOG held about 7.7% from 2020.
Alphabet Class C (GOOG) unit Waymo will launch a fully autonomous ride‑hailing service in Madrid in 2027. Jaguar I‑PACE EVs start on‑street testing with safety drivers under Spain’s DGT framework.
GOOG plans about 1 GW of data center capacity at three Vizag sites, using air‑cooled systems, on‑site zero‑discharge wastewater treatment, wastewater reuse, and dedicated industrial water connections
GOOG experienced a service outage that disrupted clients including Halifax, Lloyds, Revolut, Royal Mail, Rightmove and DPD; Revolut said customer funds and data were unaffected.
Traders note Alphabet Class C (GOOG) needs upcoming earnings showing cloud/data-center revenue growth and steady or rising AI-capex to confirm continued AI infrastructure spending.
GOOG experienced a technical outage linked to its London data center. Google acknowledged the issue, is working on repairs, and is analyzing the incident to assess scope and root cause.
GOOG: Waymo fleet runs in 15+ U.S. cities, completes 500,000+ paid trips weekly, surpasses 20 million cumulative paid trips, and reports 400+ million km of autonomous driving data.
